# Rustice Vincent Caldeo — IT Student Portfolio

> A static personal portfolio website built with Astro, React, Tailwind CSS, and TypeScript.
> It presents the owner's education, technical and soft skills, collaborative projects,
> participation certificates, and contact links.

## Site sections

- About Me
- Career Objectives
- Education
- Technical Skills
- Soft Skills
- My Projects (two collaborative projects)
- Certificates & Participation (five documented certificates)
- Get in Touch

## Stack

- **Astro** — static site generation and component composition
- **React 19** — the original LetterGlitch canvas visual
- **Tailwind CSS** — utility-first styling
- **TypeScript** — typed React component and Astro tooling
- **Montserrat** — local variable font
- **pnpm** — package manager pinned to 11.2.2

## Motion and interaction

- Animated technology marquee using skills and tools represented in the portfolio
- Expandable native HTML skill accordions
- LetterGlitch canvas animation, paused when off-screen and disabled for reduced-motion users
- Scroll-triggered card reveals and restrained hover transitions
- Native video controls for locally hosted project demonstrations

## Project notes

- The Computer Parts Inventory Management System links to the archived repository:
  https://github.com/Mikthz/New-ITE-2-Project
- Angry Birds Face AR is presented as a collaborative project with a local gameplay demonstration.
- Both projects were developed in 2026 by the same three-member team.
- The inventory walkthrough and game recording are hosted locally under `public/videos/`.
- No Firebase configuration or external runtime service is required.

## Local development

```bash
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm dev
```

## Source attribution

The site is based on the Dark Minimal template by Andres Hernandez and distributed by ThemeWagon.
The original template attribution and license are retained in the website footer and LICENSE file.
